title: Italian for Students
shortDescription: Everything an international student needs in Italy: documents, enrolment, finding a room, lectures and exams, campus life, health and part-time work.
description:
A course for students from India, Bangladesh, Pakistan and elsewhere who study — or are about to study — at an Italian university. You learn the Italian of your first weeks (codice fiscale, residence permit, bank and SIM), enrolment and fees, finding a room safely, lectures, oral exams and grades, the library and canteen, the health service and part-time jobs.

Every unit has picture words with audio, a speaking role-play (an office, a landlord, a professor, a classmate, an employer) and a review with a printable study sheet.
objectives:
Handle the offices of your first weeks in Italy
Complete your enrolment and understand fees and credits
Find a room and understand a rental contract
Talk to professors and prepare for oral exams
Use the library, canteen and study groups
Register with the health service and find part-time work

blocks.title: The situation
blocks.body: You go to the Agenzia delle Entrate (tax office) in Padua to get your codice fiscale. The clerk calls your number.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.italian: Buongiorno. Numero 42? Prego.
lines.english: Good morning. Number 42? Please come.

lines.speaker: You
lines.italian: Buongiorno. Vorrei il codice fiscale, per favore.
lines.english: Good morning. I'd like my tax code, please.

replies.italian: Buongiorno, mi serve il codice fiscale.
replies.english: Good morning, I need the tax code.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.italian: È uno studente?
lines.english: Are you a student?

lines.speaker: You
lines.italian: Sì, studio ingegneria all'Università di Padova.
lines.english: Yes, I study engineering at the University of Padua.

replies.english: Yes, here is the university letter.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.italian: Mi dà il passaporto e il visto?
lines.english: Can you give me your passport and visa?

lines.speaker: You
lines.italian: Ecco il passaporto con il visto.
lines.english: Here is the passport with the visa.

replies.english: Of course, here you are.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.italian: Qual è il suo indirizzo in Italia?
lines.english: What is your address in Italy?

lines.speaker: You
lines.italian: Via Belzoni 12, Padova.
lines.english: 12 Via Belzoni, Padua.

replies.english: I live in a university residence.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.italian: Ecco il certificato con il codice fiscale.
lines.english: Here is the certificate with the tax code.

lines.speaker: You
lines.italian: Grazie! Devo pagare qualcosa?
lines.english: Thank you! Do I have to pay anything?

replies.english: Thank you very much, goodbye.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.italian: No, è gratuito. Arrivederci!
lines.english: No, it's free. Goodbye!

blocks.title: The situation
blocks.body: You are at the student office (segreteria studenti) of the University of Bologna to complete your enrolment.

lines.speaker: Office clerk
lines.italian: Buongiorno, come posso aiutarla?
lines.english: Good morning, how can I help you?

lines.speaker: You
lines.italian: Buongiorno. Devo completare l'immatricolazione.
lines.english: Good morning. I need to complete my enrolment.

replies.italian: Buongiorno, sono uno studente internazionale nuovo.
replies.english: Good morning, I'm a new international student.

lines.speaker: Office clerk
lines.italian: Ha già pagato la prima rata?

lines.speaker: You
lines.italian: Sì, ecco la ricevuta.
lines.english: Yes, here is the receipt.

replies.english: No, how can I pay?

lines.speaker: Office clerk
lines.italian: Perfetto. Le manca solo la copia del permesso di soggiorno.
lines.english: Perfect. You're only missing the copy of your residence permit.

lines.speaker: You
lines.italian: Ho solo la ricevuta della posta. Va bene?
lines.english: I only have the post-office receipt. Is that OK?

replies.english: I'll bring it tomorrow, is that OK?

lines.speaker: Office clerk
lines.italian: Sì, va bene la ricevuta. Ecco il suo numero di matricola.
lines.english: Yes, the receipt is fine. Here is your student number.

lines.speaker: You
lines.italian: Grazie! Come posso avere la tessera dello studente?
lines.english: Thank you! How can I get my student card?

replies.italian: Grazie. Posso chiedere una riduzione delle tasse?
replies.english: Thanks. Can I ask for a fee reduction?

lines.speaker: Office clerk
lines.italian: La trova nell'app dell'università. Per le borse di studio vada all'ufficio ER.GO.
lines.english: You'll find it in the university app. For scholarships go to the ER.GO office.

lines.speaker: You
lines.italian: Perfetto, grazie mille.
lines.english: Perfect, thank you very much.

replies.english: Thanks, very kind.

blocks.title: The situation
blocks.body: You found an advert: "Stanza singola arredata, zona università, 380 €". You call the number.

lines.speaker: Landlord
lines.italian: Pronto?
lines.english: Hello?

lines.speaker: You
lines.italian: Buongiorno, chiamo per l'annuncio della stanza.
lines.english: Good morning, I'm calling about the room advert.

replies.italian: Buongiorno, la stanza singola è ancora libera?
replies.english: Good morning, is the single room still free?

lines.speaker: Landlord
lines.italian: Sì, è ancora libera. Lei è uno studente?
lines.english: Yes, it's still free. Are you a student?

lines.speaker: You
lines.italian: Sì, studio medicina.
lines.english: Yes, I study medicine.

replies.english: Yes, I'm doing a master's.

lines.speaker: Landlord
lines.italian: Bene. L'affitto è 380 euro al mese.
lines.english: Good. The rent is 380 euros a month.

lines.speaker: You
lines.italian: Le spese sono incluse?
lines.english: Are the bills included?

replies.english: How much are the bills?

lines.speaker: Landlord
lines.italian: No, le spese sono circa 50 euro al mese.
lines.english: No, bills are about 50 euros a month.

lines.speaker: You
lines.italian: Il contratto è registrato?
lines.english: Is the contract registered?

replies.english: How much is the deposit?

lines.speaker: Landlord
lines.italian: Sì, contratto registrato per studenti, e la caparra è di due mesi.
lines.english: Yes, a registered student contract, and the deposit is two months.

lines.speaker: You
lines.italian: Posso vedere la stanza?
lines.english: Can I see the room?

replies.english: When can I come and see it?

lines.speaker: Landlord
lines.italian: Domani alle sei va bene?
lines.english: Is tomorrow at six OK?

lines.speaker: You
lines.italian: Perfetto. Mi manda l'indirizzo?
lines.english: Perfect. Will you send me the address?

replies.english: Yes, see you tomorrow at six.

blocks.body: It is Wednesday office hours. You knock on Professor Conti's door to ask about the Microeconomics exam.

blocks.title: The situation
blocks.body: After the lecture, your classmate Chiara asks you about the exam next month.

lines.speaker: Chiara
lines.italian: Ciao! Sei pronto per l'esame di chimica?
lines.english: Hi! Are you ready for the chemistry exam?

lines.italian: Non ancora, è difficile!

lines.speaker: You
lines.italian: Sì, ottima idea! Quando?
lines.english: Yes, great idea! When?

replies.english: Gladly! Who's coming?

lines.speaker: Chiara
lines.italian: Martedì pomeriggio? Verso le tre.
lines.english: Tuesday afternoon? Around three.

lines.speaker: You
lines.italian: Martedì va bene. Dove ci vediamo?
lines.english: Tuesday is fine. Where shall we meet?

replies.english: I can't on Tuesday, Wednesday?

lines.speaker: Chiara
lines.italian: In biblioteca, al secondo piano.
lines.english: In the library, on the second floor.

lines.speaker: You
lines.italian: Perfetto. Porto i miei appunti.
lines.english: Perfect. I'll bring my notes.

replies.italian: Va bene. Ripassiamo i primi tre capitoli?

lines.speaker: Chiara
lines.italian: Sì! Ti scrivo sul gruppo WhatsApp.
lines.english: Yes! I'll text you on the WhatsApp group.

lines.speaker: You
lines.italian: Grazie, a martedì!
lines.english: Thanks, see you Tuesday!

replies.english: OK, bye Chiara!
